headline: Fewer and Fewer Romanians Can Afford to Set Money Aside. Only One in Four Says They Are Doing Well Financially
summary: Only 26% of Romanians say they pay their bills without worry and still have money left to save or spend, down 2.5 points from last year, according to a PwC survey.
why: Household financial health drives consumer spending, a major share of economic activity. Survey data helps investors gauge demand in consumer-facing sectors.
